name: Tile Shuffle
description: The frame is cut into tiles that swap places in pairs, round after round along the rows then along the columns, one tile of each pair lifting to swing over the other with a soft shadow; each tile turns to the second clip during one of its swaps, so the second picture arrives scrambled and the last rounds sort it out. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tiles
params.description: Number of tiles along the longer side of the frame (the tiles stay about square)

params.name: gap
params.description: Width of the gaps that open between the tiles, as a part of a tile

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadows the tiles cast

params.name: tray
params.description: Color of the tray seen under the tiles
